$comment: No angle-bracket pair. `<` is a comparison at least as often as it opens a template argument list, and auto-closing it into `a <> b` while someone types `a < b` is worse than not helping.

indentationRules.$comment: Allman braces: the house style puts `{` on its own line, so the increase must trigger on the line that opens the block, not on the declaration above it.

onEnterRules.$comment: Continue a `//|` or `//<` doc-comment run. The lexer treats every comment after the first as part of the same doc comment (`Parser/Lexer.hs:82-84`), so the continuation is a plain `//`.
